body: I had no idea this print still existed. Mama would have cried to see it this clear.
Scanned it the night I found it in the baby book. Look at the way Klara is holding her.
Grandma Sarah looks exactly like Mom did at that age. Uncanny.
Wait — this is the only photo of the two of them together? That gave me chills.
What a treasure to keep for the grandchildren. Thank you for sharing it.
